question: Analyze the binding interface between a protein and DNA molecules in a PDB structure. List protein residues within 4.0 Angstroms of any DNA atom, and DNA nucleotides within 4.0 Angstroms of any protein atom.

files.eval_guideline: Exact set of (type, chain, ID, name) records must match the reference for both protein residues and DNA nucleotides; type-label case and column names may differ; row order may differ.
files.match_reasoning: The filenames are identical (protein_dna_interface.csv) and both are CSV files. The candidate is the only output file and it matches the interface analysis task.

parameters.question: Compare protein-DNA interface tables listing protein residues within 4.0 Å of DNA and DNA nucleotides within 4.0 Å of protein (PDB 4kpy). The set of (type, chain, residue/nucleotide ID, name) records must match exactly. Type-label case (e.g., 'protein' vs 'Protein') and column names may differ, and row order may differ.

No data columns are left to compare, so column_configs is empty and scoring depends only on whether the record sets match after alignment. Type-label case and row order are allowed to differ, and alignment handles both.

notes: Scored by overlap of row keys (F1)
